registered: 2026-10-17 (correction registration, BEFORE any corrected Exp35 pattern run)
correction_reason: Exp35 v1 pattern verdicts are invalid and are archived as universal_control35_v1_invalid.json. Two design errors were found by diagnostic A/B against Exp24: (1) MONO was defined as zeros-then-ones in ascending calibrated-address order, but stored Exp24 occupation crosses from ionised (bit 0) below the address to neutral (bit 1) above it, so a threshold-compatible pattern in ascending address order is ones-then-zeros; (2) the v1 sparse random-pair hop proposal mixed too poorly in the Coulomb glass: from the same relaxed state at address-2.5 mV for site 45 (60 nm seed 0), Exp24's original Metropolis gave P_ion=1.0000 while the v1 sampler stayed at 0.0000. UC5 bootstrap did not use the defective sampler and its computation is retained for recheck; UC1-UC4 and UC6 from v1 must not be cited as physical verdicts.

corrections.patterns: MONO = ones then zeros in ascending calibrated-address order. ALT unchanged (0101). RAND = same RNG rule except non-monotone now means at least one rise 0->1 with increasing address.
corrections.sampler: Use Exp24's proposal distribution faithfully: each proposal is a single flip with probability 1/2, otherwise a hop between a uniformly chosen occupied and a uniformly chosen empty site (maintained lists, same distribution). FINAL_SWEEPS=1200, FEEDBACK_SWEEPS=600.
corrections.sampler_acceptance_gate: Before the full run, the corrected sampler must reproduce Exp24 Metropolis on seed-0 sites 45/46/73 at address +/-2.5 mV with absolute P_ion difference <=0.25 on at least 5 of 6 checks and no check on the wrong side of 0.5 by more than 0.25. If it fails, stop and do not issue verdicts.
corrections.unchanged: Island/sample selection, G/L/CL protocol definitions except the corrected pattern direction and sampler/sweeps, amplitudes, gain/clip, metrics and all UC numeric thresholds from predictions_exp35.json remain unchanged. The original predictions file is not edited.
